title.zh: 法徹法師：句句授經，癩者膚故
title.en: Master Fache: Teaching the Sutra Line by Line, the Leper's Skin Made Whole

note.zh: 絳州人，居蒲州孤山；《持驗記》列於唐朝。
note.en: A Jiangzhou man who settled on the lone hill of Puzhou; the Chiyan ji files him under the Tang.

synopsis.zh: 唐法徹，絳州人，通《法華經》，常以此經誘化。居蒲州孤山剏立蘭若；地本高險無泉，積歲崇道之後，清泉迸出，刺史房仁裕以「陷泉」題寺額。道中遇一癩者，引至山中，鑿穴給食，令誦法華；癩者素不識字，又復頑鈍，師句句教授，終不辭倦。誦至第六卷，癩病漸愈；經誦完時，眉鬚復生，皮膚如故。
synopsis.en: Fache of the Tang, a Jiangzhou man, had mastered the Lotus Sutra and used it constantly to draw and convert people. He settled on the lone hill of Puzhou and founded a hermitage; the site was high and dry without a spring, but after years of devoted practice clear water burst forth, and Prefect Fang Renyu inscribed the plaque 'Sunken Spring' for the monastery. On the road he met a leper, led him into the hills, dug him a cave, fed him, and set him to reciting the Lotus Sutra. The man could not read and was dull of mind besides; the master taught him line upon line and never once wearied. By the sixth fascicle the disease was visibly receding; when the sutra was complete, eyebrows and beard had grown again, and his skin was as it had been.

paragraphs.text: 絳州人。少勤苦，通法華經，常以是經誘化一切。邑有孤山，師依而結業，剏立蘭若。地本高險，向絕泉源。師積歲崇道，一旦清泉迸出。刺史房仁裕申請寺額，即以陷泉名之。甞於道中遇一癩者，引至山中，為鑿穴給食，令誦法華。癩者素不識字，加又頑鈍，句句授之，終不辭倦。至第六卷，癩病漸愈。經完，眉鬚復生，膚已如故。
